description: Estimate hiking time with Naismith's rule: 12 min per km plus 10 min per 100 m of ascent, with fitness adjustments.

faqs.a: Allow 12 minutes per kilometer plus 10 minutes for every 100 meters of ascent — the classic hillwalker's rule of thumb.
It assumes reasonable fitness on decent paths. Bad weather, rough terrain, or heavy packs all add time.
Choose your fitness level to adjust the estimate by ±20%, and see both moving time and pace.
faqs.q: What do the fitness options do?

howto: Enter the route distance in km.
See estimated time, pace, and adjusted options.
title: Hiking Pace Calculator
